EC1: Rest pain [OR] or tissue loss [AND] due to PAD (Fontaine stage III [OR] and IV),
EC2: acute lower extremity ischemic event secondary to [OR] thromboembolic disease or acute trauma,
EC3: Walking capacity [AND] significantly limited by conditions [NOT] other than claudication including leg [OR] (joint [OR]/musculoskeletal [OR], neurologic) and systemic (heart [OR], lung disease) pathology,
EC4: Current use of either ACE inhibitors [OR] or angiotensin II receptor blockers,
EC5: Chronic kidney disease [AND] with estimated Glomerular Filtration Rate < 30 ml/min/1.73 m2,
EC6: History of bilateral severe renal artery stenosis [OR] and 7) History of angioedema related to previous ACE-inhibitor treatment [OR] or known hypersensitivity to ramipril [OR] or other ACE inhibitors.
